exploit_name: Vault unregistering can be DoSed by depositing dust amounts
description: The unregisterVault() function performs multiple safety checks that can be circumvented by depositing dust amounts or leaving minimal claimable assets. Vaults are limited to 10 registrations.
root_cause: The unregisterVault() function performs multiple safety checks that can be circumvented by depositing dust amounts or leaving minimal claimable assets. Vaults are limited to 10 registrations.
fix_description: Allow force-unregistration with appropriate safeguards or ignore dust amounts in safety checks.
notes: Prevents vault rotation, locking protocol configuration.
